scope: Fictional preliminary annual-average budget and fixed-rate mortgage arithmetic; no completed web app, optimization, performance result or actual customer data.
units: KRW; ratios fractions; amounts unrounded internally

mortgage.first_payment_net_worth_reconciliation_n: Cash outflow includes principal+interest, principal reduces debt equally. Only interest is cost.
mortgage.conditional_note: Same rate and scheduled payments throughout; no extra prepayments/fees, no claim of future rate certainty.

education_zero_return_arithmetic.note: Zero return is an arithmetic reference, not a forecast or statement that the goal must fail. No second inflation addition to a future-nominal target.

six_month_income_stress.classification: Nonprobabilistic stress and annual-average approximation; does not prove intra-month or dated payment liquidity. No unemployment benefits or liquidation proceeds assumed.
six_month_income_stress.interpretation: Do not diagnose a current liquidity crisis: accessible principal can cover this specified average gap, but preserving the existing education earmark leaves little margin. Existing earmark principal is preserved, but future contributions pause and the goal projection changes. The missed savings are not added again as stress spending.

unsupported_conclusions: Actual bank quote or product recommendation
